messages.subject: Exchange for a smaller size
messages.text:
Hello

On December 31, 2025 I ordered two pairs of mittens, one in size medium and one in size large. The order number was L-45132. The package was delayed because of weather issues and arrived while we were away for a week. We returned yesterday and that is the reason for the delay in this request for return. The size medium fits me well but the size large is too big for my husband. The medium suits him as well. The large mittens were tried on with clean hands but are otherwise unused. I was wondering if I could return the large and exchange it for a medium. Thank-you for your kind attention. 

Sincerely, 

Adrienne Shaw

messages.subject: Re: Exchange for a smaller size
messages.text:
Hello Adrienne,
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, you need to select the products to return and then choose the ones you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer the use of envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off in a red Canada Post box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once we receive the return, we will send the new product(s). 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
